items.caption: Joanne Pressman and Sophie Pernitchi at the bimah. Ladino and Hebrew melodies at a joint bat mitzvah, 1992.
Brenda Barry, Millie Becker, and Jerry Pressman renovating CTI at 8 Pierpont Street, 1981.
Joseph Gibely in the CTI sanctuary, 1976.

July 24, 1976 — Two honored for 30 years of service. Morris Gibeley (left) and Victor Havian (center) were recognized by Congregation Tifereth Israel; congregation president Joseph Gibely (right) congratulated them. Photograph credited to Peter Zaharis. Digitally restored from a newspaper clipping; consult the original for archival accuracy.
Congregation Tifereth Israel, 8 Pierpont Street, Peabody.
Historic photograph of the congregation's early building, archival label preserved.
2006 — CTI kitchen dedication. An invitation in the historical collection identifies a June 11, 2006 celebration honoring Sheryl Becker.
Menorah lighting at the Peabody Hebrew School, 1958. Regional Jewish history, not identified as CTI.

October 1994 — Honoring Rabbi Dov B. Pikelny and Cantor Barbara Pikelny for 13 years of service. Left to right: Treasurer Jerry Pressman; Cantor Barbara Pikelny; Ladies Auxiliary President Rose Harsfield; Rabbi Emeritus Dov B. Pikelny; and President Joseph Gibely II.
April 7, 2024 — Joint Ladies Auxiliary brunch with Temple Emanu-El of Marblehead.

Our Religious Leaders — original historical page identifying Joseph Havien, David Leon and Ralph Bencangey and describing their role in CTI's earliest religious services. The source spells the first surname Havien.
2012 — Shofar gift group portrait from the Congregation Tifereth Israel historical collection.
CTI Ladies' Auxiliary officers, historical newspaper group photograph. Digitally restored and colorized interpretation; date and individual identities pending verification.
